comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the two screenshots, and @jblion for confirming it in a second setup: they showed the drop being refused rather than misplaced, which pointed straight at the cause.

What it was: a change of ours on 26 October made the main menu bar claim its whole row (so that menus could move into an overflow list at very large fonts).
